title: I wait for my turn

intro.bo: This game is for two, {nome}: you and a grown-up. You take turns. I'll watch.
intro.pilu: {nome}, call a grown-up: here you take turns, one taps and then waits.
intro.tango: Taking turns, {nome}! First you, then the grown-up, then you. Waiting is hard, I know.

offscreen: Any board game: say out loud 'your turn' and 'my turn'.

rounds.prompt: Take turns: put the story in order

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. I got a bit scared, but it worked out.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}, you looked carefully. That's enough for today.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, tomorrow we'll do another one. Now I'm off running.
